about: A low scrub bush (gorse / broom / heather type), under a metre tall: an OPEN shrub grown from a stool: thin stems, foliage in separate sprays with gaps between, a darker inside; evergreen, yellow flowers in spring. Variants: a rounded one, a low spreading one, a taller one, a sparse leggy one. Closed styles (blobby, cartoon) = separate lumps on stems. Terrain kind `bush` (squash 0.45 near cliff lips = wind-shorn)
